properties.name: Assigned To
properties.current_limitation: Not properly implemented - always empty array

properties.name: Status
properties.description: Task status (To-do, In Progress, Done, etc.)

identified_issues.description: Assigned To property not functional - always sets empty array instead of actual people
Error handling only logs to console without proper error propagation
No validation of environment variables before API calls
Main function executes on module import, preventing library usage
Notes property overwrites instead of appends when updating

assumptions_and_constraints: Notion database must be pre-created with specified schema
Integration must have appropriate permissions in Notion workspace
Status values must match exactly with Notion database status options
People assignment requires valid Notion user IDs or emails
